entities.name: Security mode control procedure
entities.description: Procedure used to activate integrity protection and ciphering for NAS signalling between UE and network.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by network to UE to initiate security mode control procedure.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by UE to network to confirm successful security mode activation.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by UE to network to indicate security mode activation failure.

entities.name: Selected integrity algorithm
entities.description: Indicates the integrity protection algorithm selected by the network.

entities.name: Selected ciphering algorithm
entities.description: Indicates the ciphering algorithm selected by the network.

entities.name: Replayed UE security capabilities
entities.description: Contains the UE security capabilities as sent by the UE in an earlier message.

entities.name: IMEISV request
entities.description: Indicates whether the network requests the IMEISV from the UE.

entities.name: NAS message container
entities.description: Contains a NAS message that needs to be integrity protected.

relations.description: Security mode control procedure includes sending SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.
Security mode control procedure includes receiving SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message.
Security mode control procedure may include receiving SECURITY MODE REJECT message.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND message contains selected integrity algorithm IE.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND message contains selected ciphering algorithm IE.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND message contains replayed UE security capabilities IE.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND message may contain IMEISV request IE.
SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message may contain NAS message container IE.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND message requires integrity protection.
SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message requires integrity protection.
SECURITY MODE REJECT message requires integrity protection.
